description: Fun Friday runs more than twenty online team-building games for remote teams, including trivia, drawing, bluffing, typing races, and more. Connect it and ChatGPT can tell you what the team could play, open a room and provide the code and join link to share, check whether everyone has joined and who is winning, and report the standings afterward. The games themselves are played by people in the browser: starting one still requires a human to press Start, and the app cannot answer, vote, guess, or draw on anyone's behalf.
